sections.Profile:
Retro Atomic Zombie Adventureland (RAZA) was an unreleased prototype from the now-defunct pinball manufacturer deeproot pinball. Based on a design from John Popadiuk, the game nearly released production status however deeproot would go out of business before it could be brought to market.

- Manufacturer: deeproot
- Years made: 2019
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: LCD
- Players: 4
- Tags: Zombies, 2010s, Original Theme, Solid State
sections.Design Team:
- Design: John Popadiuk
- Sound: David Thiel
